rules: Reactions are to specific heard lines, delivery, timing, gestures and actions, not generic song-success summaries.
Different sectors and individuals react differently; silence can mean attention, uncertainty, discomfort or lack of response, not automatically awe.
Audience perception is limited by distance, sound, prior noise and propagation delay.
A single audience shout remains a one-off event unless a causal process visibly turns it into a broader chant or recurring motif.
Do not reuse one funny heckler or one-off comment as a concert character without a real cause.
NPC knowledge is causal and limited; no omniscience or automatic information sharing.
Rena, Meira, security, technicians, volunteers and audience have distinct roles, attention and incentives.
Do not narrate Arlequino's voluntary actions, thoughts, emotions, speech or song choices beyond what the player explicitly supplies or authorizes.
Time advances by plausible performance/action duration; do not handwave songs into seconds.
Official attendance/sales figures require a causal source such as Meira/gates; visual estimates remain estimates.
